name: nowcoin-digital
description: Nowcoin Digital company website — React frontend and NestJS API

scripts.setup: npm install && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
